description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Danitha trigger, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 3, untapping it.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.
